LESSON: VISUAL DISCRIMINATION

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.4: Visual discrimination

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Visual discrimination. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Talk about differences in objects and pictures in class discrimination

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Talk about differences in objects and pictures in class discrimination
   In simple words: practise until you can talk about differences in objects and pictures in class discrimination. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Visual discrimination using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Visual discrimination in the examples.
2. Explain Visual discrimination to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Visual discrimination.
4. Show that you can: Talk about differences in objects and pictures in class discrimination

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Visual discrimination using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Visual discrimination important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
